name: Sheila Helman
source:
A figurehead empress of Helman nation and the main heroine of Rance IX.

[spoiler]After the Helman Revolution, she regained her position as the nation's leader. This time, she takes the reins and guides Helman through her own will and actions.

She has long been popular among the citizens, even winning two consecutive terms in the presidential elections. She shares no blood relation with her brother, Patton.
[/spoiler]
